text: A ProMates client says their website is down and the product launch is tomorrow morning, so customers cannot access the site before launch.
My bank sent an SMS saying ₹18,500 was debited from my account for a transaction I never made, and I need to report it immediately.
HR emailed me that my interview slot is available only if I confirm by tonight, otherwise they will give it to another candidate.
The college exam form submission deadline is tomorrow, and missing it means I cannot appear for the upcoming exams.
A client says their contact form is broken and losing customer leads, but casually says I can look at it whenever I get time.
LinkedIn notified me that my profile appeared in 12 searches this week and suggested I update my profile to attract more opportunities.
IMPORTANT: My free trial is ending soon, and the subscription will renew next week if I don't cancel it.
A friend sent me a wedding invitation for next month and asked me to let them know if I can attend.
AWS emailed me that my monthly billing statement is ready to view, showing the charges for the services I used this month.
A client asked if I could change the logo color on their website sometime next week because they want it to match their new branding.
